mainEntity.name: How do I know if an interior wall is load-bearing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Identifying a load-bearing wall requires a professional assessment. These walls support the structural weight of the house, transferring loads from upper floors or the roof to the foundation. Clues can include walls directly above a foundation beam, those running perpendicular to floor joists, or centrally located walls. Hometelligent Inc. always conducts a thorough structural analysis with a qualified engineer to confirm a wall's function before any removal, ensuring the safety and integrity of your home.
